ev.q: The odds of reporting an adverse reaction or health impact after receipt of the third dose and previous doses were compared using multivariable generalized estimating equations models.
Overall, 578 (99.5%) VAERS reports were classified as nonserious
Local injection site reactions (2,224; 68.5%) and systemic reactions (1,483; 45.6%) were frequently reported after third dose vaccination
Inability to attend school was reported less frequently after receipt of dose 3 (6.9%) than after dose 2 (10.0%) (p<0.001).
VAERS is a U.S. national passive vaccine safety surveillance system comanaged by CDC and FDA
Local injection site reactions were reported with equal frequency after dose 3 (68.5%) and dose 2 (68.0%) (p = 0.65).
